articles.summary: NEW YORK, May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vroom, Inc. (Nasdaq:VRM) today announced financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. HIGHLIGHTS OF FIRST QUARTER 2026 $98.4 million stockholders' equity as of March 31, 2026 and $86.5 million tangible book value (1) as of March 31, 2026
